title: Preflight alignment: stakeholder checklist & ping cadence for telemetry/privacy PRD
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket coordinates a short, deterministic preflight process for the telemetry & privacy changes described in the PRD (v1.3). The goal is to surface blockers early across Eng / Design / Legal and produce a single sign-off matrix plus a lightweight rollback plan before we start integration testing. This ticket does not own implementation; it drives alignment and produces a signed artifact (preflight checklist + acceptance sign-off thread).
acceptance_criteria: Engineering capacity plan (capacity/latency impact) documented and reviewed by Eng Leads
Design accessibility & UX flow review completed and open issues triaged (no high severity UX regressions)
Legal confirmation on telemetry collection scopes and data residency implications
Telemetry schema and retention parameters landed in the PRD and referenced schema repo
Rollback & fallback plan approved (including model routing fallback and telemetry toggle)
All owners added to the sign-off matrix and at least one approval from each discipline recorded in the thread
